trial: Use the registered 25 later terminal-pivot training windows. One fixed prefix and the same two ordered slots permit three distinct physical endpoints: temporal, activity, relation. The conditional temporal-versus-activity odds come from the frozen leave-dialogue-out retrieval-competition model, including its screened rule-2 local signal. The temporal-versus-relation odds come from the frozen singleton-tail semantic signal. Share temporal as one reference logit. Normalize (1, odds(activity), odds(relation)) exactly once per span. No model is refitted on these later outcomes.
controls: Compare the three-skill native policy, terminal-return baseline plus tail, raw-return-only plus tail, native activity plus tail, credit plus native relation, credit plus full-source relation, three constant skills and a constant three-action distribution matched to credit-plus-tail mean visits over comparable spans. Count the three measured answers for every matched question. Report true expected F1 under the randomized fixed prefix, per type and dialogue. Measure mean total variation from native over matched spans. Differences from the raw-return ablation isolate the incremental effect of the screened labels within this policy family.
timing: Bind the plan, original fit, cohort and source-only numerical forecasts. Disclose any relation write or answer present when this protocol was registered. Exclude those windows from the strict primary panel. Disclose previously available two-skill controls separately. Require identical prefix, retrieved state and both fixed slots across all three arms, and verify all prediction receipts and original QA indices. Do not use labels from these late windows to select a model. This training-history experiment cannot by itself validate transfer. Require +0.02 against native and terminal controls, positive against the matched-rate and raw controls, support across at least four histories and independent development before promotion.
